7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Brewberry 7 Energy is about $5.25, with 230 calories, 105 mg of caffeine and 57 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Is there a sugar-free Brewberry 7 Energy?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Brewberry 7 Energy23057 g59 g105 mg
Sugar-free Brewberry 7 Energy50 g3 g105 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Brewberry 7 Energy allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Brewberry 7 Energy. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Brewberry 7 Energy

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Brewberry 7 Energy?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Brewberry at Home (Fan Build)

7 Brew does not publish its energy base, so fans build this on a canned energy drink with the two syrups. The ratios below come from the 7 Brew recipe groups, where brewistas have confirmed them.

For one medium Brewberry

  • ½ oz strawberry syrup
  • ½ oz blue raspberry syrup
  • About 11 oz energy drink (a plain or berry one works best)
  • A full cup of ice
  • Optional: sweet cold foam on top, the finish fans recommend most
  1. Pour the two syrups over the ice.
  2. Add the energy drink and stir once. Do not shake it; the carbonation goes flat and foams over.
  3. Top with cold foam if you are using it.

Sizes: small uses the same ½ oz of each syrup with about 7 oz of energy drink; large goes to 1 oz of each with about 14 oz. Sugar-free version: sugar-free syrups and a sugar-free energy drink land near the stand's 5-calorie medium.

7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy?

A medium iced Brewberry 7 Energy has 230 calories. A small has 180 and a large 350, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy?

About 105 mg in a medium. Small is 67 mg and large is 133 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy cost?

Roughly $4.50 for a small, $5.25 for a medium and $6.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Brewberry 7 Energy?

57 g in a medium, or 0 g if you order the sugar-free version.

What flavor is Brewberry, exactly?

Blue raspberry and strawberry. That is the official menu's own formula for Brewberry, two syrups on the 7 Energy base, and despite the name there is no blueberry in it anywhere. The taste lands sweet, tangy and candy-like, closer to a berry sports drink than to any real fruit, which is exactly why it is one of the most ordered flavors on the energy menu.

Is there a sugar-free Brewberry?

Yes, and it is a bigger drop than most flavor swaps. A sugar-free Brewberry on the sugar-free 7 Energy base is 5 calories for a small or medium iced and 10 for a large, with 0 g of sugar, per the official guide. The regular medium is 230 calories and 57 g of sugar. Caffeine does not change: 67, 105 and 133 mg by size either way. Fans say the sugar-free version tastes a little less sweet but keeps the berry character.

Why do some sites list Brewberry at up to 560 calories and 152 mg of caffeine?

Those figures come from one fan guide's wide estimate ranges, and Google's AI answers have repeated them. They do not match 7 Brew's official nutrition guide. The guide's large iced Brewberry is 350 calories and 133 mg of caffeine, and the medium is 230 and 105. When a page gives you a range like 10 to 560 calories, it is mixing the sugar-free base and loaded custom builds into one number.

How does Brewberry compare to a Red Bull?

A medium Brewberry has 105 mg of caffeine in a 24 oz cup. A standard 8.4 oz Red Bull has 80 mg in the can. So the medium 7 Brew drink carries a little more caffeine in a much bigger, sweeter cup, 57 g of sugar against Red Bull's 27 g. The sugar-free Brewberry flips that comparison: same 105 mg, 0 g of sugar, 5 calories.

How do I make a Brewberry at home?

Fans in the 7 Brew recipe groups use a simple ratio on a canned energy base: for a medium, half an ounce each of strawberry and blue raspberry syrup with about 11 oz of energy drink over ice. The recipe section on this page lays it out by size, plus the cold foam finish fans swear by.
